- TOTAL revenue TW was £61.8k versus LW £42.3k, a WoW change of 46.0%.

- CHERRY DESIGN PAPERLANTERNS saw the largest WoW increase at 14999.8%, followed by BALLERINA HEART DECORATION. at 12688.5% WoW.
- WOODLAND HEIGHT CHART STICKERS rose 9879.7% WoW, while KENSINGTON COFFEE SET fell 78.9% WoW.
